title: Add isolated Whole-Book V2 product review mock
user_summary: Adds a development-only, static Whole-Book V2 report and progress prototype for product information-architecture review.
technical_summary: Implements two dev-only React routes with deterministic static mock data and dependency-free SVG/HTML visualizations; no backend requests or formal route changes.
acceptance_criteria: eight report modules render from static mock data
progress mock exposes all fifteen stages and requested metrics
chapter heatmap aggregates 1299 chapters instead of rendering 1299 cards
formal whole-book route and backend remain unchanged
verification_evidence: Targeted Vitest: 2 files / 6 tests passed (final mock polish)
